name: Bemmoly
description: Bemmoly is self-hosted issues and docs for a whole team: projects, Kanban and Scrum boards, sprints and a roadmap next to a live collaborative wiki, with Jira and Confluence import, OIDC/SAML single sign-on, SCIM, webhooks, an MCP server and optional bring-your-own-model AI. MIT licensed with no paid edition.

notes.text: Open the URL and the setup wizard creates the first admin account.
Behind a reverse proxy or domain, set BEMMOLY_PUBLIC_URL and BEMMOLY_TRUST_PROXY=true in /opt/bemmoly_data/.env, then run systemctl restart bemmoly.
Updates go through this script's update command; the in-app updater is for the Docker install and does not apply here.
